meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你找学术论文时,用论文搜索工具按关键词、作者或主题检索多个平台(如 arXiv、PubMed 等),返回相关结果。
howto.when: 当你说“搜索论文”“查找研究论文”“搜索 arXiv”等,或提到要找科学文献时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下关于强化学习的论文
say.note: Claude 会启动论文搜索工具进行检索。

say.text: 在 arXiv 上找近年的目标检测文章
say.note: 限定平台搜索,结果更聚焦。

say.text: 用 PubMed 搜一下高血压相关研究

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses paper-search tools to retrieve academic papers by keyword, author, or topic across platforms such as arXiv, PubMed, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'search for papers', 'find research papers', 'search arXiv', or similar lookup requests.

say_en.text: Search for papers on reinforcement learning.
Find recent object detection articles on arXiv.
Look up hypertension studies on PubMed.
